description: We are a team of six passionate and innovative minds: *Dhruva, Sumit, Daksh, Aakarsh, Kevin, and Roshan, participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our team focuses on **web-based game development*, combining creativity, technology, and problem-solving to transform complex ideas into engaging and interactive experiences. We aim to explore space-related challenges through innovative  solutions that inspire curiosity, promote learning, and make science accessible and enjoyable.
